verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail advertises 'automation rules' for mail handling and offers Zapier/API access to build custom workflows, which supports rule-based triggers on mailbox events. However, there is no detail on what events/conditions/actions are supported, no rule-builder documentation, and no OpenAPI/dev docs were reachable (probes 404), so depth of the automation engine is unverified. Missing for 10: concrete rule definitions (trigger types, conditions, actions), API/OpenAPI documentation confirming programmatic rule creation, and independent confirmation of rule engine capabilities.
